name: Create Color Wheel & Art Elements Flipchart
description:
Create a 3-page Art Lesson flipchart in ActivInspire.

Your task is to build a structured visual aid for a color theory lesson:

1. Page 1 (Title): Create a title page with the text "Color Theory" and a subtitle "Elements of Art". Add at least one decorative shape.

2. Page 2 (Color Wheel): Create a diagram with at least 6 distinct shapes arranged in a circle or wheel pattern. You must label them with text:
   - Primary Colors: Red, Yellow, Blue
   - Secondary Colors: Orange, Green, Violet (or Purple)
   - Fill the shapes with the corresponding colors using the Fill tool.

3. Page 3 (Reference List): Title this page "Elements of Art" and create a text list of the seven elements:
   - Line, Shape, Form, Space, Color, Value, Texture

Save the completed flipchart to: '/home/ga/Documents/Flipcharts/color_wheel_art.flipchart'
